data.name: Je Di Bo
data.detailed_description:
Chess Tactics Meet Absolute Chaos!

Je Di Bo is a unique turn-based tabletop strategy game that blends the strict logic of chess with the unpredictability of a card roguelike. Forget memorized openings and predictable lines: here, a single dice roll or a well-timed Karma card can instantly change the rules of the game. Your ultimate goal is the total annihilation of enemy forces. No compromises, just pure tactical victory.

Key Features:

  • Three Ranks, Endless Possibilities: Control Circles, Squares, and Triangles. Each geometric piece possesses its own unique movement and capturing mechanics. Guide a humble Triangle across the entire board to trigger a "career lift," evolving it into a Square, and eventually into a devastating Circle that strikes in any direction!

  • Up to 5 Moves Per Cycle: Plan intricate tactical combinations by moving multiple pieces in a single turn. But choose your moments wisely: the moment you attack and capture an opponent's piece, your movement cycle immediately ends.

  • Karma Cards: Every 7 moves, the Turn of Karma begins. Players draw cards from the deck that can turn the match completely upside down. Activate a "Blitzkrieg," plant a "Spy" deep in enemy territory, or pray that the dice don't select your lane as the "Line of Death."

  • Two Board Formats & Flexible Timers: Engage in massive battles on the classic 12x12 grid, or switch to the dynamic Split-version (8x8) for quick sessions. Customize the match timer to fit your playstyle, from lightning-fast 10-minute blitzes to deep, thoughtful hour-long games.

Choose Your Game Mode:

  • PvP Battles: Clash in casual Quick Matches or prove your supremacy in intense Ranked PvP Matches as you climb to the top of the leaderboards.

  • Competitive Mode (Sport): For purists and tactical masterminds. The impact of randomness is strictly limited as Karma cards can only be drawn 10 times per match. Show off your raw intellect.

  • Casual Mode (Entertainment): A chaotic, fun-first mode with no limits on Karma card draws. A true test of your ability to adapt to a constantly shifting storm of random events!

  • Single-Player (PvE): Hone your skills against an adaptive AI bot, practice your setups in Self-Play mode, or embark on a fully realized PvE Campaign.

Full Battlefield Customization

Create a unique atmosphere for your victories! Je Di Bo features deep customization: unlock and swap stunning game board skins, choose stylish 3D models for your geometric pieces, personalize your Karma card designs, and explore beautifully detailed background environments.

Are you ready to challenge both fate and your opponent? Wishlist Je Di Bo on Steam right now!

data.short_description: Je Di Bo is a chaotic, deep turn-based card strategy where chess-like logic meets unpredictability. Move pieces, upgrade their ranks, and dominate the board. But beware: every 7 turns, Karma rolls the dice and completely changes the rules of engagement. Can you outsmart the chaos?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 / AMD Radeon RX 460 (minimum 2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 (Big Sur) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (2.5 GHz or higher) or Apple Silicon (M1)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics / AMD Radeon Pro 555X or integrated Apple M1 graphics (Metal API support required)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
